attributes.name: image_shape_and_crop
attributes.definition: How images/thumbnails are cropped or shaped (aspect ratio, corner treatment) and whether sizing is uniform or distorted.

values.definition: Images cropped to consistent squares with rounded corners.
Images stretched, oversized, or sized inconsistently, breaking uniformity.

attributes.name: image_content_type
attributes.definition: Whether image slots show distinct real photos, repeated placeholders, or non-photographic colour blocks.

values.definition: Each image slot shows a different real photo.
The same placeholder image is reused across multiple slots.
Images are replaced by flat or gradient colour blocks.

attributes.name: thumbnail_row_arrangement
attributes.definition: How small thumbnails are laid out relative to each other.

values.definition: Thumbnails sit in a tight, centered, evenly sized row.
A uniform row is disrupted by one enlarged item.
No thumbnail row or other arrangement.
